svg.title: Christopher Woodyard · Vers3Dynamics
svg.desc: Christopher Woodyard. Vers3Dynamics, an independent open-source laboratory. I make strange things and test whether they work. Beside the name, a cabinet of sixteen specimen drawers, each labelled with a project and a small drawing: R.A.I.N. LAB (flask), PINE GAP (radome), MANNAHATTA (storm), GHOSTWHEEL (wheel), JAMES (cursor), DNA MUSIC (helix), ASCENT (house), NOCTURNE (moon), LUCA (lens), JASMINE (flower), TRIAD (triad), QUBIT NOISE (noise), IONS-X (swarm), CIRCLE (pulse), PROJECT 33 (rocket), and one empty drawer marked with a question mark for the next experiment. Below the name, the Adinkra symbol Nea Onnim No Sua A, Ohu: one who does not know can know from learning.
